data.title: Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025 – Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf
data.summary: The Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf issued David Muster's income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, setting income tax at €11,405.00 and requiring an additional payment (Nachzahlung) of €634.00 by 30 April 2026.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment for 2025. After crediting the wage tax already withheld, you still owe €634.00, due by 30 April 2026 — pay it to the Finanzamt's account by then to avoid late-payment surcharges. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt in writing, electronically via ELSTER, or in person; the app shows the objection deadline based on when this letter is deemed delivered. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final after that deadline.
